split-card-gap.looks: Two panels side by side: a photo on the left; on the right a heading, a paragraph, a 2x2 grid of small icon-and-label benefits, and up to two buttons.
split-card-gap.use: A recruiting or programme pitch with two to four short benefits, e.g. 'Join Our Team'.

fields.title: A one to three word benefit, e.g. 'Mission-Driven'.
